what_happened: The job was a follow-up to fix the t3 trigger wording on the firstmate page and make the decider test structural. It was rejected at the final verdict. 1 of 7 acceptance criteria was unmet: running `cargo run -p xtask -- site` must build and validate the study. The generated page must keep the in-scope glossary entry and a next-step link before the first transition card, and must have no f2/f3 model-limit note. There was one major finding: the page still shows the f3 model-limit finding (studies/firstmate-work-handling/findings.json:13-18; xtask/src/site.rs:501-509). No failed checks are listed. The other 6 criteria were met, so the t3 wording and the structural test may be fine. The gap is that the page still renders the f3 finding that the criterion says must be absent.
cause: Nothing in code checks the generated page against the criterion's absence conditions before handover. The producer can change the data or the wording and still leave the renderer (site.rs) emitting the f3 note from findings.json. The criterion is about what the built page contains, but only the verifier's reading of the output at the final verdict compares the two, and there rejection is the only outcome. This is the third follow-up on the same page, and each one fixed the named findings without re-running a check on the whole page against every criterion. This is an inference, since the stored fields do not show what the producer ran.
prevention: Add a test in the site build that renders the firstmate study page and asserts the output. It must contain the glossary entry and the next-step link before the first transition card. It must not contain any f2 or f3 model-limit note. The producer must run it, and a failure must block handover. More generally, every criterion about page contents or absences should have a matching assertion on the generated HTML, run before the job goes to the verifier.
proposed_request: On the firstmate-work-handling study page, remove the f3 model-limit finding from the generated page, and make sure the f2 model-limit note is also absent. The cause is the page still rendering it from studies/firstmate-work-handling/findings.json (lines 13-18) via the renderer in xtask/src/site.rs (lines 501-509); change whichever of the data or the renderer is needed, and keep the t3 trigger wording and the structural decider test as they are. Acceptance: (1) `cargo run -p xtask -- site` builds and validates the study. (2) The generated page keeps the in-scope glossary entry and a next-step link before the first transition card. (3) The generated page has no f2 or f3 model-limit note. (4) A test in xtask renders the page and asserts criteria 2 and 3 on the generated HTML, and fails if the f3 finding is put back. (5) The other findings and their rendering are unchanged. (6) The report lists the commands run and their results.
